fields.name: target_cube
fields.description: Position [y, x] of the cube the demonstration picked up: the cube that is listed as 'held in the gripper' (or vanishes from the table list while the gripper is closed) during the DEMONSTRATION STEPS, located where it sits on the table in the scene at the start of execution (it is set back down at nearly the spot it was lifted from, and the shuffle at the end of the demonstration returns it there). At every later step the value is refreshed to the current table position of that same cube (the listed cube nearest the previous value, within about 10 px) whenever it is resting on the table; while the cube is held in the gripper the value is left unchanged. e.g. [93, 140]

fields.name: picks_done
fields.description: Count of completed pick-ups in the execution so far. It is 0 at the first decision step. It goes up by one at each decision step whose own scene (the last frame) shows the gripper raised (height about 0.14 or more) with fingers partly closed on the cube (about 46% open, cube held in the gripper or missing from the table list). It does not change at decision steps whose last frame shows the fingers 100% open. e.g. 1
